You are here: Home / Products & Solutions / ConFlame-FRLS

 

Cable Structure

Conductor The conductors, drawn from bright electrolytic grade copper and annealed and bunched together.
Insulation The bunched conductors are insulated with specially formulated Heat Resistance Flame Retardant Low Smoke & Halogen Compound. During a fire situation, the FR-LSH compound restricts the spread of flame. The smoke emission is also minimal.
Marking The cables are printed with generic marking ‘CONFLAME Green+’.
Colors Red, Yellow, Blue, Black, Green and Grey.
Packing 90 Meters (apprx.100 yards) pack in protective cartons.
Test Specification Specified Values
Critical Oxygen Index ASTM-D 2863 Minimum 31%
Temperature Index ASTM-D 2863 Minimum 250 °C
Acid Gas Generation IEC 60754 -1 Maximum 20%
Smoke Density Rating ASTM-D 2843 Maximum 60%
